title: You Will Get Rejected If You Walk Into Interviews Like This
description:
Most candidates lose the interview before they even answer the first question.

You already beat hundreds of applicants to get the interview. Stop walking in like you need them to like you.

Want the full system to stop freezing in interviews and turn interviews into offers? Watch my full video here:

https://youtu.be/VvaFE--lEws

#interviewtips #jobsearch #careeradvice #interviewprep #jobinterview #careertips
transcript: You will get rejected if you walk into your interview thinking they're doing you a favor. Most candidates lose a job before they even answer a single question because they walk in like, "Wow, I hope they like me." No. You walk in like, "They've already chosen me. Now I'm just confirming it." You've made it through hundreds of applicants. That wasn't luck. That was a decision. If you don't believe you're the best candidate, why should they? I'm Kate Currier, career strategist and your career bestie and I break down exactly how to walk into your interview as the obvious choice. And if you want the full simple six-step strategy, make sure to check out my full video and follow along.
